title: The Scholar's Tower
text: A tower crammed with books to the rafters, mouldering, stacked on the stairs, and a scholar too old to leave it, thin as a quill, ink-stained to the elbow. He offers to teach one of you anything in exchange for news of the world. He has not seen anyone in a very long time.

options.label: The most curious learns from him.

outcomes.text: A week's lessons in a night, and a head too full to sleep.

options.label: Tell him everything. He is lonely.

outcomes.text: He listens like a child, and gives you a map in thanks.

options.label: The Leader takes the rarest books.

outcomes.text: He weeps, and does not stop you, and you can hear him for a long way.
